baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ joins recollection, the Lord's designation, and prayer with ف.
baseline_models.mechanism: A held or recovered awareness is given a definite object by the Lord's name; the name identifies the one who nurtures and completes, and the following prayer converts that awareness into ordered bodily worship.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something to mind supplies the inward recovery that initiates the sequence.
Name as raised designation gives recollection a definite, speakable point of orientation.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the named Lord the agent of sustained formation rather than a bare title.
Prescribed worship supplies the enacted form into which recollection passes.

changed_reading.before: He remembers the name of his Lord and then prays.
changed_reading.after: Recovered awareness of the nurturing Lord is not left mental; ف turns it into a completed, embodied act of worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَكَرَ can be voiced mention, while ٱسْمَ and فَصَلَّىٰ can carry public elevation and supplication.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord's designation is made to run on the tongue and thereby raised into public presence; prayer then answers that voiced elevation as praise, blessing, appeal, and reception of mercy.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue makes the first act audible rather than merely interior.
Honorable mention and renown make the utterance an act of raising repute.
Rising high supplies the vertical effect assigned to voicing the name.
Lordship and authority identify whose repute is raised and toward whom the response is directed.
Supplication, praise, and mercy make prayer a responsive appeal rather than only a ritual label.

changed_reading.after: Voicing the designation raises the Lord into acknowledged public presence, and prayer continues the same event as praise and appeal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory behind ٱسْمَ permits the name to activate a visible mark and a sign read by discernment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The name functions not only as a label but as an identifying trace. Recollection recognizes that trace as evidence of the Lord's formative care, and prayer makes the recognition bodily legible.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark turns the name into a trace by which belonging can be recognized.
A sign read by discerning observation supplies the act of inference from mark to source.
Bringing to mind supplies recognition of the identifying trace.
Nurture and completion identify the care inferred from the mark.
Prescribed worship becomes the visible response that makes recognition inspectable.

changed_reading.before: The name is the verbal object of remembrance.
changed_reading.after: The name is also read as an identifying trace of formative lordship, and prayer is the body's displayed recognition of that trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening command to worshipfully declare the name of the highest Lord is answered in the focus by mentioning that same name and praying. The focus therefore reads as enactment and completion of the opening imperative.

activation_trace.role: Voiced mention supplies the focus act that answers the earlier command.
Prescribed worship supplies the bodily completion of that answer.
Worship through glorification and prayer supplies the opening command's ritual scope.
Name as raised designation repeats the focus object's exact functional identity.
Lordship and authority repeat the relational title that governs the focus response.
Height and elevation give the opening naming act a vertical direction that the focus performs.

structural_cues: 87:1 and 87:15 repeat ٱسْمَ رَبِّ in the same order, with an opening imperative and a later completed-action sequence.
The focus ف links mention to prayer, while the opening cue already places glorification and prayer in one worship branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition, an imperative, elevation, and a worship branch. I infer that 87:15 answers 87:1 by enactment; a live alternative is that the two formulas recur without a command-fulfillment relation.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an individual's spontaneous remembrance and prayer.
changed_reading.after: The focus performs the surah's opening command: the highest Lord's designation is voiced, then the commanded glorification becomes prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord named in the focus is characterized by measuring, straightening, planning, guiding, tending, and allowing growth to pass into debris. Prayer can therefore be read as embodied alignment with a governed order that includes both formation and dissolution.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the continuous formative agency named in the focus.
Following the leader in second place supplies a bodily image of alignment behind that agency.
Measuring and proportioning supply the first operation in the created order.
Straightness and intrinsic completion supply the ordered condition toward which formation moves.
Deliberate apportioning and planning make the order directed rather than accidental.
Gentle indication toward a way supplies movement through the measured order.
Shepherding care and protection materialize the nurturing dimension of lordship.
Pasture becoming brittle debris prevents alignment from meaning attachment to one stable created form.

structural_cues: 87:2-5 presents linked divine actions in a measured sequence from formation and guidance through pasture to dark debris.
The focus names رَبّ after this sequence, allowing the relational title to gather those operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered creative operations, nurturing care, dissolution, and a prayer branch of following. I infer an analogy between cosmic ordering and bodily alignment; a live alternative is that the creative catalogue only motivates praise.

changed_reading.before: Prayer follows recollection as a devotional response.
changed_reading.after: Prayer places the body behind the measured, guiding, nurturing order carried by the Lord's name, including consent to created forms passing away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus recollection becomes the downstream completion of a relay: recitation is imparted, forgetting is checked, a reminder is issued, benefit is tested, and an awed recipient recollects. Prayer is enacted retention, not an isolated mental event.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing to mind supplies the focus endpoint of the mnemonic relay.
Prescribed worship turns retained content into durable performance.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation supply the transmitted content at the relay's source.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure that the promised recitation prevents.
Reminder and admonition convert retained recitation into a stimulus passed onward.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the relay's functional test.
Fear joined with awe supplies the receptive condition under which reminder becomes self-recollection.

structural_cues: The forms move from causative recitation in 87:6 to an imperative reminder in 87:9 and reflexive recollection in 87:10.
The focus repeats ذ ك ر after this relay and immediately gives it a bodily consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, non-forgetting, reminder, benefit, awe, and later recollection. I infer a transmission chain ending in prayer; a live alternative is that the focus describes a generic worshipper outside that chain.

changed_reading.before: The worshipper independently remembers and then prays.
changed_reading.after: The worshipper is the receptive end of a recitation-reminder circuit, and prayer is memory successfully carried into action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Voiced mention and visible prayer make orientation publicly legible, but the manifest trace does not exhaust the act. The contrast between what is announced and what is hidden places the external sign under a knower who sees both.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue supplies the audible exterior of remembrance.
A sign read by discerning observation makes the name-prayer sequence socially legible.
Prescribed worship supplies the visible enacted trace.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies knowledge that is not limited to public display.
Announcement and raised voice define the manifest side of the act.
Concealment and hiddenness preserve an inward side not readable from the mark alone.

structural_cues: 87:7 explicitly pairs the manifest with what remains hidden under divine knowledge.
The focus itself moves from a potentially voiced act to a publicly recognizable bodily act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public utterance, a readable sign, hiddenness, and encompassing knowledge. I infer that outward prayer manifests but cannot certify inward recollection; a live alternative is that جهر and خفي concern only the range of divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Mention and prayer together provide a complete portrait of devotion.
changed_reading.after: Mention and prayer are the public trace of devotion, while their hidden orientation remains known beyond what observers can infer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer's follower image is activated by divine facilitation toward ease. Remembering the Lord's name reorients the worshipper, while prayer is the light, compliant motion made possible along the eased way.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the authority and direction behind which the worshipper moves.
The second racer following at the leader's flank supplies prayer's kinetic alignment.
Opening and ease after difficulty make the path available rather than self-produced.
Lightness and compliance in motion give the enabled path a bodily quality.

structural_cues: 87:8 uses a causative first-person plural promise of facilitation before the reminder and response sequence.
The focus prayer follows the remembered name with ف, fitting movement made ready toward a direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine facilitation, easy compliant motion, authority, and a follower image. I infer that prayer is enabled alignment rather than autonomous exertion; a live alternative is that ease refers only to the messenger's broader mission.

changed_reading.before: The worshipper decides to pray after remembering.
changed_reading.after: Remembering catches an already facilitated direction, and prayer is the worshipper's light movement into line behind it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same reminder divides recipients: awe permits useful recollection, while the most burdened moves it to the side. The focus depicts one realized branch of reception, where recollection crosses into worship.

activation_trace.role: Recovered presence supplies the receptive branch realized in the focus.
Prescribed worship makes reception consequential rather than merely cognitive.
A reminder that restores presence supplies the common stimulus offered to both paths.
Benefit opposed to harm defines successful uptake of the reminder.
Fear with awe supplies the openness through which reminder becomes recollection.
Moving aside, distancing, and estrangement supply the competing response.
Hardship and burdensome suffering characterize the path that evades the reminder.

structural_cues: 87:10 and 87:11 place recollection and avoidance in immediate contrast.
The repeated indefinite مَن in 87:10 and 87:14 lets the focus continue a typology of response rather than only narrate one person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one reminder, beneficial recollection under awe, avoidance, and the focus's enacted recollection. I infer a branching response mechanism; a live alternative is that the verses list fixed person-types without depicting a dynamic fork.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a general recipe: remember, then pray.
changed_reading.after: The focus shows the receptive outcome of a live fork: one lets reminder become worship, while another shifts it aside and enters hardship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The neighboring ṣ-l-w/y inventories hold both prescribed prayer and exposure to fire. Against the one who encounters the greatest fire, the focus presents one who directs the same sound-and-branch field toward worship, praise, and mercy.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the focus pole of the lexical reversal.
The focus split inventory's fire encounter keeps the opposed pole latent inside the focus form.
Encountering fire and its heat makes the latent opposed pole explicit in context.
Kindled fire and branding by it materialize the destructive encounter.
Magnitude opposed to smallness intensifies the contextual fire pole.

structural_cues: يَصْلَى in 87:12 and فَصَلَّىٰ in 87:15 are close sound-neighbors and resolve through overlapping split root inventories.
The contextual sequence contrasts avoidance ending in fire with purification, remembrance, and prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit fire encounter, a prayer sense, and overlapping mapped inventories. I infer a rhetorical reversal within the ṣ-l sound field; a live alternative is accidental formal proximity with no intended contrast.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is unrelated to the earlier punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: Prayer becomes the constructive orientation of a lexical field whose contextual alternative is being made to encounter the greatest fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flourishing is activated as both the farmer's opening of soil and durable success, while purification is also growth. Remembering the nurturing Lord and praying become stages in cultivation: clearing, orienting, and producing a visible living act.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and stage-by-stage completion supply the cultivation carried by the Lord's title.
Recovered presence supplies the orientation of the cultivated subject.
Prescribed worship supplies the visible act produced by the cultivation sequence.
The farmer cutting open the earth supplies the material operation behind flourishing.
Attainment and lasting survival supply the result sought by cultivation.
Growth and increase make purification productive rather than merely subtractive.
Purity and soundness supply the clearing operation that permits growth.

structural_cues: 87:14-15 forms one مَن sequence: flourishing belongs to the one who purifies, remembers, and then prays.
The focus's ف makes prayer the nearest visible issue of the preceding inner and relational acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agricultural cutting, durable success, purification, growth, nurture, and a linked grammar. I infer a cultivation mechanism in which prayer is fruit or shoot; a live alternative is a non-material list of independent virtues.

changed_reading.before: Purification, remembrance, and prayer are adjacent conditions of success.
changed_reading.after: Success is cultivated: purification opens and clears, the Lord's remembered nurture directs growth, and prayer emerges as its visible living result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus contrast exposes a rival selection rule: immediate life wins because it is near, whereas the later good endures. Remembering the Lord's name changes the scale of salience, and prayer performs preference for what is deferred but lasting.

activation_trace.role: Bringing the Lord to mind counters the perceptual dominance of what is merely near.
Prescribed worship embodies the revised preference rather than leaving it an opinion.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the explicit selection operation.
Life as benefit and good explains the genuine attraction of the selected object.
Nearness supplies the salience bias that makes immediate life prevail.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal disadvantage of the competing object.
Seeking good through choice supplies a corrected criterion of selection.
Continuance and remaining supply the horizon that outweighs immediate nearness.

structural_cues: بَلْ immediately after the focus overturns the focus pattern with the audience's actual preference.
87:17 opposes temporal lateness to superiority and duration, making the issue a comparison across horizons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit preference, nearness, delay, chosen good, duration, and a contrast marker. I infer that remembrance recalibrates salience and prayer enacts the new ranking; a live alternative is that 87:16-17 rebukes a separate fault after the focus.

changed_reading.before: Prayer follows remembrance as an act of devotion.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is a performed preference: remembrance breaks the monopoly of the near and chooses the deferred, better, enduring horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of remembrance as a rights document or legal instrument is activated by the written former sheets. Mentioning the Lord's name and praying can therefore be carried as enactment of an inherited covenantal record, not invention at the moment of devotion.

activation_trace.role: A document of right turns remembrance from mental recall toward an inspectable inherited instrument.
A covenant or binding pact supplies the relational force carried by that instrument.
Prescribed worship supplies performance of the record rather than mere archival possession.
A written sheet supplies the physical medium that activates remembrance's documentary branch.
The repeated written-sheet image ties the teaching to named earlier carriers.
Beginning and temporal precedence place the record before the present performance.

structural_cues: 87:18 uses هَٰذَا after the focus sequence and locates its referent in earlier written sheets.
87:19 repeats the sheets and names earlier transmitters, giving the claim historical depth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a documentary branch, a covenant branch, written former sheets, and a backward-pointing deictic. I infer that the focus sequence is enacted inheritance; a live alternative is that هَٰذَا points only to a broader teaching, not specifically to 87:14-17.

changed_reading.before: The worshipper recalls a name and performs a present act.
changed_reading.after: The worshipper activates an older binding record: naming acknowledges its Lord, and prayer performs the inherited claim in the present.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins non-dominant name-as-rain-mark, Lord-as-cloud, pasture, growth, and a plant branch inside the prayer inventory. It remains anchored in ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ and in the packet's pasture-purification sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as an ecological material analogy, never as a claim that فَصَلَّىٰ lexically means a plant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱسْمَ activates the first rain's vegetal mark, رَبّ activates the nurturing rain-cloud, and the split فَصَلَّىٰ inventory carries a grazing plant.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation lets the name act as a life-bearing signature.
A low persistent cloud that nurtures plants supplies the named Lord's ecological agency.
The grazing plant branch lets prayer appear, cautiously, as visible growth under that agency.
Pasture and grazing supply the living field in which the material analogy operates.
Pasture becoming dry debris makes the devotional growth fragile rather than triumphally permanent.
Growth and increase reconnect purification immediately before the focus to the vegetal field.

changed_reading.before: The worshipper names the Lord and performs prayer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Lord's name falls like a rain-mark that makes inward cultivation visible as prayer-growth, even while the pasture cycle warns that visible forms can become debris.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the technical image of the second horse whose head reaches the leader's rear flank. It remains anchored in the focus prayer branch and is reinforced by contextual guidance, facilitated motion, and succession; downstream prose should retain it as a spatial metaphor for close following, alongside rather than instead of ritual prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَصَلَّىٰ follows the named Lord with ف and carries a branch image of the racer immediately behind the leader.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify the one whose lead orders the movement.
The second racer at the leader's flank supplies the precise spatial image of close following.
The guide who advances at the front supplies a contextual leader for the focus follower image.
Light compliant motion explains how the follower stays close rather than struggling independently.
One thing following another supplies a second packet-supported image of ordered succession.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a stationary rite performed after naming.
changed_reading.after: Prayer also images taking the nearest following position behind the authority just named, moving where guidance has already opened the way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries fire-straightening from a non-dominant focus mapping into prayer and places it beside punitive fire. It remains anchored in فَصَلَّىٰ, contextual straightening, explicit fire, and purification, but downstream prose should mark it as an abductive transformation image, not derive ritual prayer from burning or equate worship with punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory of فَصَلَّىٰ includes heating and turning a stick over fire to straighten it, while the focus stands between explicit fire and purification.

activation_trace.role: Kindling and fire-straightening supply the focus's latent formative heat image.
Straightness and completion supply the shape toward which disciplined formation moves.
Fire used to straighten makes the material operation explicit beside the punitive fire scene.
Purity and soundness direct the heat image toward formation rather than destruction.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, prayer continues purification as a chosen formative exposure that straightens the self, reversing the contextual fire from destructive encounter into discipline.

strongest_changes: The repeated ٱسْمَ رَبِّ frame makes the focus an enacted answer to the opening command, not only a private devotional report.
The recitation, non-forgetting, reminder, awe, and avoidance sequence turns recollection into the successful branch of a mnemonic relay whose result is bodily prayer.
The immediate purification grammar makes remembrance and prayer stages of cultivated flourishing, while بَلْ recasts prayer as a performed preference for the deferred and enduring.
The overlapping prayer and fire inventories sustain a contained reversal: worship occupies constructively the sound-field whose competing contextual outcome is fire exposure.
The former written sheets activate remembrance as document and covenant, making the focus an enactment of inherited obligation.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings kept unusually productive readings alive: ٱسْمَ could be a raised designation, a readable mark, or even a rain-mark of growth, while فَصَلَّىٰ could retain ritual worship yet activate close following, fire reversal, and formative straightening. These readings coexist without collapsing the strong recollection-to-prayer baseline.
remaining_uncertainties: ف clearly orders mention before prayer, but the degree of causality rather than close sequence remains open.
The sign, rain, follower, and fire-straightening models depend on non-dominant or form-distant branches; their value may be rhetorical activation rather than lexical sense.
The scope of هَٰذَا in 87:18 may include the focus sequence specifically or a wider block of teaching.
The created-order analogy can make prayer embodied alignment, but the same cues may function more simply as reasons for praise.
